Celina paid 13 and a half million dollars for the old grain silos by downtown, and now we know what it wants to build there.

Celina's Economic Development Corporation showed a draft master plan Sept. 28 for the Willock Tract, about 32 acres of old grain silos near downtown. It bought the land in 2024 for $13.5 million from a half-cent sales tax.

The draft keeps the silos and adds a brewery and beer garden, food halls, live-music restaurants along Doe Branch Creek, a hotel with a conference center, and retail and offices along Oklahoma Drive. City council sees it Oct. 13. Rezoning and tenants come after that.

Celina's median sale over the last 12 months was $512,250, down 7.6%.

Would you walk here from the square?

Kevin Grant, Realtor | Pax Realty
